Maria S: heads-up — Prospect (EU-regulated fintech) asked for an HSM-backed CMK, monthly rotation, and assurance that keys never leave their control. They want a POC next month and asked for ballpark pricing for Dedicated + HSM. Can infra/legal weigh in?
Jason T: short answer: doable but a few tradeoffs. We support BYO-HSM and cloud HSM integrations (AWS CloudHSM, Azure HSM, GCP KMS). Two models: 1) Redwood-managed HSM nodes in Dedicated pool (we provision, we manage attestation) or 2) customer-provided HSM via VPN/VPC peering and on-prem network.
Jason T: provisioning lead time for option 1 is ~2–4 weeks (ordering, attestation, certs). Option 2 depends on customer's ops cadence — can be faster if they already have HSM reachable.
Jason T: latency note — each unwrap/crypt call to HSM adds ~5–15ms depending on region/peering. For high QPS (they mentioned ~500 qps) we recommend session-based KEK caching + local unwrap at session start to avoid per-token KMS calls.
Alex P: from inference side, prefix/KV cache and batching will reduce calls. Plan: unwrap KEK during session init, keep session KEK in secure enclave memory for X minutes, rotate by issuing new sessions post-rotation. That keeps steady-state latency <10ms overhead.
Sarah L: security/legal checklist highlights: FIPS 140-2/3 validation for HSM, attestation reports, key-escrow policy (they want zero-escrow), split-knowledge/key ceremony requirements, access logs for every unwrap/rotate, and SOC2 + encryption-in-transit/proof for cross-region replication. Also confirm whether customer requires HSM attestation on each rotation.
Maria S: customer explicit asks: (a) attestation per rotation, (b) private key never exported, (c) timeline for POC start 4/15, (d) pricing estimate for Dedicated capacity + HSM monthly, and (e) SOW language for rotation SLA.
Jason T: operational proposal: use Dedicated pool with dedicated HSM group (single-tenant), enable automatic monthly rotation orchestrated by the customer via our control plane trigger (we can execute rotation, but keys never leave their KMS if BYO). For attestation we can provide signed certs + HSM logs.
Jason T: short config example for POC side (high-level):
```
REDWOOD_KEY_PROVIDER: aws-cloudhsm
REDWOOD_KEY_ID: arn:aws:kms:eu:123456:key/abcd-ef01
KEY_ROTATION_WINDOW_DAYS: 30
KEK_SESSION_TTL_SEC: 3600
```
Maria S: good — can legal confirm if signed attestation + rotation logs satisfy them, or do they require a physical ceremony at our site?
Sarah L: signed attestation + HSM audit logs typically sufficient. If they insist on physical ceremony we need SOW for on-site ops + travel — that'll be a separate cost and timeline. Also need to confirm retention window for rotation logs (they asked 7 years). That's longer than default 1 year; ops + storage pricing needed.
Alex P: one more perf detail — if they want per-request signing (rather than session KEK) we should warn them: at 500 qps that's a lot of HSM ops; cost and latency will scale linearly. Recommend session unwrap pattern for POC.
Maria S: pricing ask — what should I quote as a ballpark for initial proposal (no final numbers)?
Jason T: ballpark structure: 1) one-time HSM setup/attestation fee, 2) monthly dedicated HSM rental + Dedicated GPU pool, 3) premium for long-term retention of rotation logs, 4) optional on-site key ceremony cost. For the POC quote, give a range and mark TBD for attestation/on-site costs.
Maria S: ok — I'll draft a POC SOW with those line items. Action items: @Jason T provide a short attestation checklist and sample log output; @Sarah L confirm whether signed attestation + logs = acceptable; @Alex P provide recommended KEK TTL and perf guidance for 500 qps. POC target kickoff 2026-04-15.
InfraBot: reminder — raise a provisioning ticket for Dedicated HSM pool with tag `sales-poc-2098765432`. ETA for ticket owner assignment: 1 business day.
Jason T: I'll drop the attestation checklist and example logs to this thread by EOD.
Sarah L: I'll ping customer legal and loop back re: ceremony vs signed artifacts.
Maria S: perfect — thanks all. I'll prepare the draft quote and SOW and share for review before EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
